patronOf.en-US: The Body of Christ is shown to the people
patronOf.pt-BR: O Corpo de Cristo é mostrado ao povo

meta.basis: After the words of consecration the priest genuflects, then 'elevat in altum Hostiam, et intentis in eam oculis populo reverenter ostendit adorandam' (Ritus servandus VIII.5). Meanwhile the server 'manu sinistra elevat fimbrias posteriores Planetae, ne ipsum Celebrantem impediat in elevatione brachiorum … et manu dextera pulsat campanulam ter ad unamquamque elevationem' (VIII.6); the thurifer, kneeling, incenses the Host three times (VIII.8; Fortescue, l. 9949–9962). The picture is the Consecration card of batch 47, with its initial changed from C to E.
meta.excerpt: content/do/web/www/missa/English/Ordo/Ordo.txt and Portugues/Ordo/Ordo.txt, # Canon: the rubric after the consecration of the Host, 'Look up at the Sacred Host, with faith, piety, and love, saying: "My Lord and my God."' (the words the rubric gives the faithful; verbatim in both languages)

history.note: The Consecration card of batch 47, renamed: its picture is the elevation of the Host. Only the initial was changed, C to E; the excerpt and basis are now the traditional rite's (dossiers/batch-58.md).
